EXPLANATORY

NOTE
and specifications and of helical for

Th'is standard is one of the series of standards on design, calculation coiled springs. &her standards in this series are: IS : 7906( IS : 7906( IS : 7906( IS : 7906( IS : 7906( Part 1 )-1976 Helical compression springs made from circular section Part 2)-l 975 Helical compression circular section wire and bar springs: Part wire and bar

1 Design

calculations

springs: Part 2 Cold coiled spr~ings made from for

Part 3)-1975 Helical compression springs:. Part 3 Data sheet for specifications springs made from circular section -wire and bar Part 4)-1987 Helical compression springs: Part 4 Guide for selection cold coiled springs made from circular section wire and bar Part 5)-1979 Helical circular section bar compression springs: Part 5 Hot coiled 6 Design springs and

of standard made from for

IS : 7906 ( Part 6 )-I 978 .Helical compression springs: Part springs made from rectangular section bar steel IS : 7907( IS : 7907( IS : 7907(

catculations

Part 1 )-1975 Helical extension springs: Part 1 Design made from circular section wire and bar Part 2)1976 Helical extension circular section wire and bar springs: Part 2 Cold

and calculation coiled sheet springs

for springs made from for

Part 3 )-1975 Helical extension springs: Part 3 Data springs made from circular section wire and bar

for specifications

This standard aims at rationalization of various sizes of extension springs by eliminating the unnecessary sizes and retaining only those most commonly used in the industry. This standard is expected to be of considerable help to the spring designer who can choose the spring required by him from the list nearest to the characteristic required in the spring designed by him. Some of the most commonly used springs may be available as standard springs stocked by the spring manufacturers. In this standard, the unit of force N used is newton (N).

1 kgf = 9.80665 = 9.8'i N

= 10 N (within

2 percent

error).
